title: L2 close-out: Serum Swap (Solana SPL token-swap AMM) + Cega V2 (Ethereum/Arbitrum Treasury)
headline_note: E-U bug-based = $0.00 (high) for both targets; the $4.22 is residual stale-price arbitrage on Serum Swap ConstantPrice pools at live-DEX realizable prices (med-high). DefiLlama-price upper bound $15,186.78 (not realizable); $13,414.58 requires holding unmarketable Sollet tokens.

cega-v2.resolution_note: DefiLlama cega-v2 listing = the Treasury custody contracts (recovered adapter projects/cega-v2/index.js @28c8691a); the CEGA_STATE/LOV/FCN products are the older EVM deployment (cega-v1 listing) and are out of scope

key_facts: Serum Swap: E-U bug-based $0 (high) - LP-burn-gated withdrawals (sim-proven), PDA authority 292/292, pre-#1794 single-sided withdraw over-charges (sim-proven), no admin/sweep instruction, 0 Stable pools (OtterSec rounding bug has no target)
Serum Swap: $4.22 realizable stale-price arb; $15,186.78 at DefiLlama prices (not realizable); $13,414.58 requires holding unmarketable Sollet tokens
Cega V2: E-U $0 (high) - Treasury withdraw gate, RedepositManager gate, share-bounded user flows, trader-gated queues/settlement/fees, admin-gated setters; 3/3 fork tests prove reverts

caveats: Public-RPC rate limits forced conservative sampling in the Cega vault census and the Solana LP-holder census
The Serum $4.22 is arbitrage (normal AMM mechanics), not a code flaw; the $0 bug-based verdict is the high-confidence headline
No secrets, no mainnet writes; all simulations/PoCs are read-only
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$4.22 live total (Serum Swap stale-price arb at realizable prices; $0.00 from any code flaw on either target); $63.7k is LP-holder-redeemable, $249.9k is privileged (Serum upgrade authority/fee account + Cega 2-of-6 Safes and trader EOAs).
